reviews.use_summary: Jointly analyzed four summary-statistic sets: aortic valve area, mean gradient, peak velocity and aortic stenosis. The Methods report MTAG1.0.8 with default settings and calculation of maxFDR. Enhanced statistics were subsequently used for polygenic scores.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: GWAS, METAL meta-analysis, phenotype construction, PRScs scores and external validation are separate. Complete literal flags, source commit, input files and maxFDR grid are unreported; default settings do not supply a complete command.

reviews.use_summary: Initially assessed genetic correlations across DCM, NICM, HCM and eight left-ventricular MRI traits. Selected Ecc and indexed LV end-systolic volume from two clusters with positive rg>0.7, then combined those two GWAS with DCM using default MTAG parameters. Reported maxFDR0.03 and an approximately73% effective-sample-size increase for DCM.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Trait screening and the initial correlation matrix are distinct from the final three-trait run. Supply declared per-SNP effective sample sizes from the authors method. Full input bytes, source commit, exact flag list and maxFDR grid remain unknown; do not replace positive rg>0.7 by an absolute-correlation rule.

reviews.use_summary: Combined the primary GWAS with cardiac-MRI traits selected for absolute genetic correlation |rg|>0.7 after separate LDSC screening of ten traits. The paragraph explicitly reports mtag1.0.8 and maxFDR2.7%.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: METAL meta-analysis and LDSC1.0.1 screening are separate steps. Complete selected input files, commands, covariance/reference choices and maxFDR grid are not specified in this paragraph; do not infer the final trait set from the ten screening candidates.

reviews.use_summary: Jointly analyzed EUR cannabis-use-disorder summary statistics with alcohol-use disorder and FTND nicotine dependence. Removed duplicate SNPs, MAF<=0.01 and strand-ambiguous variants beforehand. Reported5894946 cannabis variants after QC and3540940 after the joint MTAG analysis; significance P<5e-8.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Upstream EUR GWAS/meta-analysis and duplicate/MAF/strand QC are separate. MTAG version, exact commands, per-SNP sample-size inputs and covariance/reference settings are not reported here. The reported total AUD/FTND sample sizes do not establish every per-SNP N.

reviews.use_summary: Compared six selections of MDD-related GWAS inputs to create integrated LifetimeMDD statistics. Evaluated sensitivity to the input phenotypes and ten-fold prediction with GWAS and MTAG confined to each90% training fold, followed by separate PRSice scoring on held-out participants. Used MTAG-derived effective sample sizes for downstream LDSC.
reviews.implementation_scope_note: Imputation and PRS construction/evaluation are separate. Complete six trait sets require the figure/supplement; the primary paragraphs do not give an exact MTAG version, command or maxFDR grid. MTAG effective sample size, case-control effective N and imputation-related effective N are distinct definitions and must not be interchanged.
